items.statement: Export growth 5% in FY24; US share grew from 2.87% to 3.6%; major challenges in African and South American countries due to currency constraints
items.quote: There was about 5% growth in the exports in this financial year, in the last financial year.

items.statement: Export challenges in African and South American countries due to foreign exchange shortages; European recession from Russia-Ukraine war impacting some markets
items.quote: The major challenges we are facing for the exports are in some African countries and South American countries. So, these are the two continents where we have not been able to grow. But we have been able to maintain the same level of exports.

items.statement: Company holds cash reserves (INR28-48 crores) and evaluating inorganic growth opportunities including acquisitions outside India
items.quote: We are looking at different opportunities, options to invest with this cash reserve. So we are looking at opportunity to invest or acquire some companies so that we can have some inorganic growth.

items.statement: Export margins approximately 10-12% higher than domestic margins due to higher international pricing
items.quote: Yes, yes. Approximately about 10%-12% difference.

items.statement: Capacity utilization at 45% with 55% unutilized capacity; R&D centre approved by Ministry of Science and Technology; 17 academic institution tie-ups
items.quote: Our current capacity utilization stands at 45% for the existing product line, indicating that we still have 55% unutilized capacity.

items.statement: North and West regions grew ~10% YoY in Q4; UP, Bihar, Maharashtra improved 20%, 14%, 10% respectively; rural demand subdued in Q2-Q3 but portfolio optimization from Rs 799-2,999 addressing gaps
items.quote: So during the quarter, right, so we've seen increase in our North and West business by almost like a 10% increase year-on-year. And the other regions have sort of been flattish, like East and Central and South have more or less been flat.

items.statement: Premiumization slowed; pivoting to economical portfolio (Rs 899-1,000 MRP) to drive volume and operating leverage; ASP may not grow at same pace but offset by higher volumes
items.quote: So therefore, we've pivoted to the strategy of increasing our economical portfolio as well. That is from 899, basically up to 1000 bucks MRP. So that would definitely give us additional volume. And any margin there would be compensated by additional volume from and create operating leverage.

items.statement: Aspire to maintain EBITDA margins 17%-19%; Q4 FY24 delivered 18.3%; A&P spend to continue at 6%-7% of revenue
items.quote: So going forward, certainly we'll aspire to maintain our margins in the range of, | would say, 17% to 19% EBITDA levels that is the aspiration, and even in this quarter four, we've delivered at 18.3

items.statement: Plan to open 80-100 EBOs per year from FY25 onwards, mostly FOFO; maintain ~75:25 FOFO:COCO ratio
items.quote: But going forward, as we see better visibility and | would say, BIS impact also coming in, we would certainly like to get back on track in terms of opening about 80 to 100 stores from FY25 onwards again, most of which would be FOFO

items.statement: BIS norms require non-BIS inventory upload by Aug 1, 2024 and liquidation by June 1, 2025; importers loaded inventory early; green shoots from import decline expected in 2-3 quarters
items.quote: But because the BIS norms dictate that we need to upload the non- BIS inventory onto the portal by 1st of August this year, and the government has given time till 1st of June 2025 to liquidate all non-BIS goods, therefore we believe that a lot of, | would say, importers did some loading of inventory early on

items.statement: Channel inventory fairly in control; only 1-2 areas slightly elevated but not concerning
items.quote: It is fairly in control. We don't see barring maybe just one or two areas, which is not very concerning. We are fairly comfortable in terms of channel inventory at the moment.

items.statement: Complete portfolio segregation across channels: online/offline separate, EBO common, LFS specific; added open category (sandals, slippers, school shoes) for seasonality
items.quote: So portfolio is specific to each channel. So we don't have a common portfolio anymore. There is no conflict, especially between the online and GTM, between GT. So there is a complete segregation of portfolio across all price points between both the channels.

items.statement: Trade distribution grew 7.5% YoY in Q4; D2C declined 6% (B2B/O2O down 55%, marketplace up 32%); net value growth ~4.7%; D2C offline (COCO/FOFO/LFS) grew 30-40%+
items.quote: So we've seen about 7.5% growth in terms of value in our trade channels in Quarter 4. And this is primarily due to these two or three initiatives that we have quite aggressively run.

items.statement: Paid off Rs 156.5 cr debt in FY24; achieved net debt-free status; highest ever net operating cash flow Rs 264.5 cr; working capital cycle reduced from 108 to 79 days
items.quote: The company paid off debts amounting to Rs. 156.5 crores in FY24, reaching a net debt-free status during the year. It gives me immense pleasure to share that Campus Activewear generated the highest ever net operating cash flow of Rs. 264.5 crores in FY24.

items.statement: No numeric guidance given; aspire to maintain/grow business from current levels; confident of double-digit then mid-teen growth if macros stable
items.quote: So we do have a good visibility in terms of getting there sooner than later. The only question remains again is in terms of macros, as long as they remain stable and not too volatile or too depressed, right? | don't see really much of a challenge from here on, given the new strategy that we've pivoted to

items.statement: Non-Par share of individual APE more than doubled to 18.32% in FY24 from 8.89% in FY23
items.quote: Further, the welcome reception by our customers to our new Non Par products such as Jeevan Utsav has added strength and confidence to our belief that our strategy is on Life Insurance Corporation of India May 28, 2024 right track

items.statement: Target Banca channel share to grow to 5-6% from current 3.61% in FY25
items.quote: We want to grow at least 5-6% from present 3.61% share of Banca to total our business. So, that will grow at least 5%, 6%. That is our target for Banca.

items.statement: VNB margin expanded 60 bps to 16.8% in FY24 despite PAR and group margin pressure
items.quote: Further, the net VNB margin for FY24 is 16.8% as compared to 16.2% for year ended March 31st 2023. Hence, the VNB margin has expanded by 60 basis points on a year on year basis.

items.statement: Agency transformation project Jeevan Samarth launched to strengthen Tier-2, Tier-3 and rural presence
items.quote: This year we have also taken one project, Agency Transformation Project for the current year. We call it Jeevan Samarth. So, that is just started.

items.statement: Target at least one LIC agent in every panchayat in FY25 to deepen rural penetration
items.quote: This year we have taken a target; we should represent every panchayat. Every panchayat in the country must have one LIC agent at least. So, that is the target for the current year.

items.statement: Excess expense of management of Rs 5,477 crore for FY24 and Rs 7,230 crore for FY23 to be amortized over 3 years from FY25
items.quote: Note number 10 provides for excess of expense of management of 5,477 crore for '23-'24. And both these expenses will be amortized over a period of 3 years starting from '24-'25.

items.statement: Six new Non-Par products launched in FY24 including Jeevan Kiran, Jeevan Utsav, Jeevan Dhara-II, Dhan Vriddhi, Index Plus and Amritbaal
items.quote: Continuing with our strategy of increasing the proportion of the Non par business, we launched six new Non par products during FY 2023-24 to cater to customer requirements, namely, LIC's Jeevan Kiran, LIC's Jeevan Utsav, LIC's Jeevan Dhara - II, LIC's Dhan Vriddhi, LIC's Index Plus and LIC's Amritbaal, respectively.

items.statement: PAR and group VNB margins declined due to falling risk-free rates and annuity benefit enhancements
items.quote: As regards the margins, yes, the margins under PAR and group had fallen mainly because of the movement in the risk-free rates. And in the case of group, the benefit enhancement done in the annuities is the major cause of it.

items.statement: Regulatory discussions ongoing on surrender regulations and trail commission model; no final outcome yet
items.quote: So far as this regulation is concerned, we as insurance companies, we have placed before regulator our views. Discussion is going on. Some final outcome will come which will be in the best interest of customers as well as industry.

items.statement: Surplus distribution to shareholders in PAR business increased from 7.5% to 10% from FY25
items.quote: From this year onwards. From '24-'25, it will get increased.

items.statement: Protection APE including riders grew ~6% to ~Rs 201 crore in FY24; working on more term product variants for FY25
items.quote: If we include the rider premium for the current year and last year, it's a Non-PAR protection would be around 201 APE would be there as compared to 190 last year. So, almost 6% growth would be observed there.

items.statement: Digital transformation to be experienced by stakeholders before end of calendar year 2024
items.quote: We are moving ahead steadily on our digital transformation project and I hope that before the end of this calendar year, our stakeholders start experiencing the changes in our digital transformation.

items.statement: Board recommended final dividend of Rs 6 per share for FY24 in addition to Rs 4 interim dividend
items.quote: I would like to share that the Board has recommended a Final Dividend of Rs. 6/- per share in its meeting held on 27th May, 2024, subject to shareholders approval. This is in addition to Rs. 4/- per share interim dividend that was declared and paid earlier during the year.

items.statement: Revenue estimated to grow at approximate 20% CAGR for next 3 years with Gross Margins maintained in 11% to 13% range
items.quote: Given the macro development of the credit card industry, the higher base of the business model and ever -changing industry scenario, we estimate that our Revenues would grow at an approximate 20% CAGR for the next 3 years and maintain Gross Margins in the range of 11% to 13%.

items.statement: Full year FY24 Gross Margin at 12.1% in line with 11%-13% guidance; Q4 FY24 Gross Margin at 12.5%
items.quote: For the full year, our Gross Margins were at 12.1%, in line with the guidance of 11% -13%.

items.statement: Adjusted EBITDA margin improved quarter-on-quarter from 7.4% in Q1 to 9.7% in Q4 FY24, up 226 basis points
items.quote: On a quarter-on-quarter basis, driven by our concentrated focus on improving operational efficiencies, innovations and collaborations, we have been increasing our Adjusted EBITDA margins from 7.4% in Q1 to 9.7% in Q4, up by 226 basis points.

items.statement: Services other than India airport lounge now contribute 6% of revenue, up from <2% in FY22; expect 15%-20% contribution in next 4-5 years
items.quote: The services other than the Indian airport lounge now contribute 6% to our Revenue, which was less than 2% in FY22. We remain focused on increasing the contribution of these services and expect these services to contribute around 15% to 20% in the next 4 to 5 years.

items.statement: Credit card industry structural shift to spend-based benefits implemented in Q3 FY24; revenue growth was 47% vs potential 65% without the model change; impact expected to stabilize by Q3 FY25
items.quote: We have been addressing the ongoing structural changes in the credit card industry whereas the card issuers are moving to a spend-based benefit structure instead of a blanket card benefit. This change was implemented in Q3 of this year, and we will continue to see the changes across the providers until the spend-based system is in place. This structural shift in the model meant that our revenue gr

items.statement: Volume impact from spend-based programs ongoing in Q1 and Q2 FY25; expected to stabilize by Q3 FY25
items.quote: In the coming quarter, we see that 2 or 3 large clients, we have already got the dates in terms of the spend -based solution that they have adopted, and we are still yet to see the volumes that will get impacted. To my mind, I think we will see through this in Q3 probably. So, the volume will stabilize in Q3.

items.statement: No major capex disclosed; asset-light model maintained; cash and equivalents INR101 crores; net worth up 50% to INR236 crores
items.quote: We continue to have a strong balance sheet with our Net Worth up by 50% to INR236 crores compared to last year. Our Cash and Cash Equivalents balance as at quarter end stood at INR101 crores.

items.statement: Board recommended final dividend of INR1.5 per share for FY24; with interim dividend of INR0.50 in Q1 FY24, annual dividend equals 100% of face value
items.quote: Further, I'm happy to share with you that our Board has recommended a final dividend of INR1.5 per share for FY24. We had paid an interim dividend of INR0.50 in Q1FY24, which takes our annual dividend to 100% of the face value.

items.statement: Global lounge partnerships with Plaza Premium and Grey Wall expanding international network; Singapore office established with senior hire to target Southeast Asia market
items.quote: In global, we are in process of adding more and more lounges and different touchpoints. When we say touch points, it would be meet and assist, the airport transfer, the spas and the F&B outlets as well.

items.statement: Railway lounge business grew 3.5x in FY24; 100% coverage maintained across 14 railway lounges
items.quote: Our Railway Lounge business has also witnessed a robust growth and has grown by 3.5x in FY24 from the previous year. We continue to maintain 100% coverage in railway lounges as well, with the presence of 14 railway lounges across India.

items.statement: Highway lounge aggregation initiated with 2 lounges; expect significant growth over 5-10 years driven by EV charging infrastructure
items.quote: In fact, we have already added someone from the South, a company who currently has aggregated only 2 lounges. However, I do not want to really dilute it by saying that it is two lounges, considering that in the coming 10 years, we will see a lot of electric vehicles on the road. And because of which the number of lounges on the highway will increase.

items.statement: Global lounge commercials not yet at par with India rates; expect to achieve similar commercials as volumes build
items.quote: In terms of the pricing, I would say that it was not in line with what we have in the India market. Of course, in India market, we enjoy the best of the commercial s because of the volume, what we drive there. And subsequently, it will take time for us in the global market also to enjoy the similar type of commercials.

items.statement: Non-lounge services carry higher margins than airport lounge hero product
items.quote: We have better margins. See, our hero product is airport lounge. Any other services beyond airport lounge has typically higher margins than the airport lounge. Yes, to answer your question. Yes, it is affirmatively, yes, higher margins.

items.statement: Operating cash flow conversion at ~20% of EBITDA; net cash from operating activities INR22 crores in FY24
items.quote: If you look at it from an EBITDA standpoint, we have recorded cash flow of INR97 crores against which we have a net cash generated from the operating activity of INR22 crores. So close to 20+ percentage is what is our conversion cycle.

items.statement: Management is reassessing mid-teens growth guidance for FY25 due to US large ag softness; will provide updated guidance in a couple of months
items.quote: we are now reassessing that and probably in a couple of months we would be in a more clear position on what type of top line growth are we be looking at for the current financial year

items.statement: Q1 FY25 revenue expected to be sequentially flattish vs Q4 FY24
items.quote: Q1 could be sequentially broadly flattish in that range

items.statement: Medium-term EBITDA margin target remains 20-21%
items.quote: definitely our medium-term target is to get back to 20% to 21%

items.statement: Capex plan for FY25 is about INR40 crores
items.quote: The capex for this year is about INR40 crores plan

items.statement: New business awards at INR175-200 crores for FY25 (Year 0 and Year 1), but implementation timelines may elongate due to end market softness
items.quote: new business, that is right in the range of INR175 crores to INR200 crores is the number that we are expecting in the current year which includes the year 0 and year 1 what we call it

items.statement: US large ag showing early slowdown signals materializing with adverse impact expected vs FY24; small ag down ~50% in FY24, now steady on reduced base; aftermarket down ~30% in FY24, inventory correction over, early green shoots visible
items.quote: early signals of slowdown in US large ag, as indicated in the previous 2 quarters, have started to materialize and expect it to have adverse impact on demand vis-a-vis FY '24

items.statement: Construction steady in US (China+1, Infra Bill), Europe slight softness, Japan steady; India tractor soft, recovery linked to monsoon and exports
items.quote: On the construction side of the end market, the U.S. market for us is steady with new business driven by China plus 1 and US Infrastructure Bill. Europe is witnessing slight softness, while Japan is largely steady

items.statement: Q4 FY24 EBITDA margin 17.8%, FY24 full year 18.5%; gross margin stable 63-65% range gravitating to 64%
items.quote: EBITDA margin reported at 17.8% for the quarter 4 and 18.5% for the full year FY '24, respectively

items.statement: Inflationary cost pressure in medium term to be partially mitigated through operating efficiencies; freight impact from Red Sea minimal and recoverable
items.quote: Inflationary pressure of the cost remains in the medium term to be partially mitigated through operating efficiencies

items.statement: 3PL share shifted; construction cycle did well in FY24 offsetting weak tractor cycle; PMP predominantly construction, some large ag; new fabrication orders materializing, hydraulics progressing, PTO on back burner
items.quote: while the 3-point linkage remained weak, which is the tractor cycle remained weak, but the construction cycle did well in the last completed fiscal

items.statement: Macro concerns: global economic slowdown, geopolitical uncertainties, high interest rates remain key monitorables; US small ag softness linked to interest rates, recovery expected when Fed cuts rates
items.quote: Macro concerns over global economic slowdown, geopolitical uncertainties and impact of worldwide high interest rate continues to remain a key monitorable

items.statement: Dividend policy of 25% to continue, likely 35-40% payout given strong cash flows (FY24 operating cash flow ~INR200 crores); inorganic acquisitions being evaluated but no targets finalized
items.quote: we think we should be in the same percentage simply because the cash flows are - generation is pretty good, in fact, last year, the cash flow was, like I mentioned, is about INR200 crores

items.statement: Net debt-free with net cash ~INR113 crores as of March 2024; net working capital 152 days, decreased ~INR64 crores in FY24
items.quote: Uniparts' balance sheet continues to be net debt-free, with group net cash position at approximately INR113 crores at the end of March 2024

items.statement: Capacity utilization ~60% in FY24 with adequate headroom; fungible across 3PL and PMP; special capex for new projects plus regular replacement and debottlenecking
items.quote: the last year closed at around 60% level. I mean this is a broader approximation, a little here or there. And so there is adequate headroom as far as normal products are concerned

items.statement: Aftermarket: added 2nd largest US store group, commenced sales in Q4, YTD calendar sales >$0.5M, mid-term target ~$2M; top 3 customers ordering more as inventories too low
items.quote: the new account on the aftermarket side, which is the second largest store group in the, US So we commenced sales to them in Q4 and YTD calendar year seems to have already crossed 0.5 million with them

items.statement: South America (Brazil, Argentina) emerging as new geography opportunity from existing customers' manufacturing there
items.quote: recently, we've already seen as a geography, South America, there is some fairly good requirements coming in. Also from the same customers that we have already for their manufacturing requirements, what they manufactured in South America

items.statement: Targeting 7.5-8% EBITDA margin for FY26 after expecting ~6% in FY25
items.quote: But for the next year, we are very keenly working towards getting back to a 7.5% to 8% EBITDA margins.

items.statement: FY25 capex guided at Rs 20-25 crore excluding potential Rajasthan factory spend
items.quote: So, in FY25, I think we expect to spend anywhere between Rs. 20 crores to Rs. 25 crores just a caveat here.

items.statement: First export order for fans from US company to commence in Q3 FY25
items.quote: For the first time in fans, we have also won an export order from a company in USA. This too shall commence from Quarter 3 FY25.

items.statement: Small BLDC fan order won from top-5 OEM, expected to scale up in subsequent quarters
items.quote: We have won a small order of BLDC fans with a top 5 OEM as well. We expect that this will scale up during subsequent quarters.

items.statement: Gross margins stable at 24% for Q4 and full year FY24, demonstrating pricing pass-through ability
items.quote: Gross margins have been stable at 24% for the quarter as well as the full year, clearly demonstrating our ability to pass on pricing to our customers.

items.statement: Employee cost expected to change marginally by -2% to +2% from current levels despite new hires
items.quote: Overall basis and Praveenji you can come in here if you have any other specific inputs to share, but we expect a marginal decline in the range of -2% to +2% from the employee cost numbers that we currently have that is the expectation.

items.statement: Lighting commoditized products seeing 3-4% quarterly price erosion for last 2-2.5 quarters; commodity costs rising since March
items.quote: we are seeing a price erosion of anywhere between 3% to 4% on quarter at least for the last 2 quarters to 2.5 quarters.

items.statement: Expect raw material inflation pressure but difficult to pass on; may need engineering value-add to maintain prices
items.quote: I think we might not see such steep quarter-on-quarter decline maybe in the next quarter or next coming quarter, but there will be an inflationary pressure to increase prices however, that will be difficult to pass on, so we still need to come up with innovative solutions, engineering value add to somehow maintain the prices.

items.statement: No revenue decline from Signify after exclusivity ended; seeing uptick in solar category demand
items.quote: In fact, currently we are seeing an uptick in demand, especially in the solar category of our product line, so I would just like to say it is a very amicable opening up of the business for us.

items.statement: OFR radiator heater and OTG oven toaster grill launches in FY25; OFR market size ~Rs 400 crore, first local manufacturer
items.quote: to the best of our knowledge is around the Rs. 400 crores rupee mark. This largely is being met through imports like I said to the best of our knowledge there is no one doing this in India.

items.statement: Heated Hair Brush and Electric Sterilizer launched; Trimmer 3000 to launch in Q2 FY25 for Philips (OEM)
items.quote: the Heated Hair Brush and Electric Sterilizer and Trimmer 3,000 it will be launched and the revenues will start, the contribution will come in in Q2 FY25.

items.statement: Ceiling fan weakness due to key customer being new entrant struggling to establish market toehold
items.quote: in the ceiling fan category till now our customer is a fairly new entrant in the fan business and they are also I can say a little struggling to have establish toehold in the market and that is the reason why the numbers have kind of gone down a little bit there.

items.statement: Capacity utilization subpar: lighting 65-70%, fans 45-50%, appliances ~55%, motors 60-65%; 100% utilization revenue potential ~Rs 1,600 crore
items.quote: If we just theoretically assume that we can utilize 100% of our capacity, the revenue number that we can do comes to approximately Rs. 1,600 crores.

items.statement: Professionalizing organization with new CEO Praveen Tandon (ex-Dixon, IFB, LG, Honda) and more key hires coming
items.quote: In April 24, we announced hiring of Mr. Praveen Tandon as CEO. Praveen comes with strong experience of 30 years in procurement, operations and business development across leading companies such as Dixon Technologies, IFB, LG Electronics and Honda.

items.statement: Expect double-digit PBT in upcoming quarters
items.quote: Going forward, we are confident of delivering double-digit PBT numbers in the quarters ahead.

items.statement: Expect double-digit revenue growth in ISCS segment for FY25
items.quote: And I will stick my neck out and say we are very confident of a double-digit growth in ISCS on the back of these pipeline deals that are getting converted.

items.statement: Target IFM run-rate profitability by Q2 FY25
items.quote: And by the time we close Q2 of FY25, it is our expectation that we will hit the run rate profitability that we would like to get to in

items.statement: Expect interest expense to remain around INR16.6 crores per quarter
items.quote: As a result, our interest expense, which was running at about INR41 crores per quarter in Q1 has now come down to INR16.6 crores and that is the range in which we expect to see in the next few quarters.

items.statement: Capex guidance maintained at 1% to 1.5% of revenue
items.quote: So, our capex guidance does not change. I think we will still keep it between 1% to 1.5% of revenue.

items.statement: Deal pipeline presents revenue opportunity in excess of INR4,000 crores for current year
items.quote: Our pipeline of new opportunities is strong and currently presents a revenue opportunity in excess of INR4,000 crores.

items.statement: ISCS segment margins improved 130 bps YoY to 10.2% for FY24
items.quote: On a full-year basis, ISCS segment margins were 10.2%, which was 130 bps higher compared to the year-ended March 2023.

items.statement: Consolidated adjusted EBITDA margin improved 80 bps YoY despite revenue decline
items.quote: On a full-year basis, revenues were down by 7.9% year-on-year, while adjusted EBITDA improved by 80 bps.

items.statement: Variable margins improved ~300 bps YoY in Q4 and full year
items.quote: And that has been called out in the earnings presentation. The other major line I'd like to talk about is employee benefit expenses.

items.statement: Implementing pricing revisions in IFM to pass through cost inflation
items.quote: In IFM, we are currently implementing pricing revisions with our customers and executing operational efficiency initiatives aimed at margin improvement.

items.statement: Completed one round of price increases in IFM UK, working on second round
items.quote: We have done one round, which has been passed through, and we are in the process of doing a second round. And that's why we gave out Q2 as the target, because by then we hope to complete most of the pricing actions.

items.statement: ISCS pipeline deals typically take 6-9 months to convert with 4-10 week ramp-up
items.quote: Typically, ISCS pipeline takes about six to nine months to fructify. So, today, the INR4,000 crores pipeline is in various stages of conversion.

items.statement: GFS volumes stagnant globally, recovery dependent on trade volumes picking up
items.quote: Volumes have been fairly stagnant, and this is not just TVS supply chain solutions. Our peers, the volumes have been fairly moving in a very, very narrow range.

items.statement: Red Sea surcharges not fully passed through, impacting reported margin percentage
items.quote: So if you ask me, the one risk factor at the moment is the – I mean, it will not make a difference to the dollar per container that we earn, but it will make a difference to the reported percentage margin.

items.statement: Fully repaid long-term debt and substantial working capital borrowings using IPO proceeds and internal funds
items.quote: We have completely used the IPO proceeds as well as funds from internal sources to repay all our long-term debts and a substantial portion of our working capital borrowings.

items.statement: Business development contributed INR218 crores in Q4 and INR881 crores for FY24
items.quote: For full year '24, revenue from operations was INR9,200 crores compared to INR9994.4 (Rectified with correct data) crores last year. Despite an approximately INR1,600 crores decline in the GFS business on account of pricing, annual business development revenues of INR881 crores and momentum in the ISCS segment has enabled us to deliver INR9,200 crores revenue.

items.statement: Targeting 20-25% YoY top-line growth and 20% CAGR over next few years
items.quote: With a large addressable market and a product basket of nearly 0.13 million SKUs and continuous R&D , we are poised to growour top line by 20% to 25% YoY, keeping the quality norms at the forefront. We also remain committed to increasing our product portfolio and wallet share going forward to a chieve a CAGR of 20% over the next few years.

items.statement: Consolidated EBITDA margin target of around 15% for FY25
items.quote: So on a conservative side, t his is what we want to look at, 10% for aluminum die casting, double digit I'm sayin g. And at a consolidated, we should be around 15%.

items.statement: Electronics business EBITDA margin target of 20% for FY25
items.quote: For Electronics business, I can straight away very confidently tell that 20% is our EBITDA for the Electronics business, which is about 60% to 63% of our turnover.

items.statement: Aluminum die casting EBITDA margin target of double-digit (minimum 10%) by end of FY25
items.quote: On the die casting side, we are trying to get into double digit minimum by end of this financial yea r.

items.statement: Standalone India business targeting 18-20% revenue growth and 20% EBITDA margin for FY25
items.quote: And we are budgeting about 18%, 18% to 20% of growth we have budgeted. 20% is what we have budgeted for the growth. And EBITDA, we will remain at 20%.

items.statement: Solar inverter business targeting INR 100 crore revenue in next 3 years
items.quote: So it has, as we believe, has a potential to add significant revenues in the next 2 to 3 years, and we believe that it can become about INR 100 crore company in the next three years.

items.statement: MIDC approval received for 6-storied building in Nashik to double electromechanical capacity; construction to finish by end of FY25, operational in Q1 FY26
items.quote: We have been granted approval of the MIDC in Nasik to set up 6 storied building to double some of our existing capacities in core business segments. Further, in Polish entity, LUMEL SA, we have already placed order for new SMT line, which will be operational within this financial year.

items.statement: New SMT line ordered for LUMEL SA Poland, operational within FY25; new state-of-the-art SMT line with clean room, AOI and X-ray being finalized for India
items.quote: Further, in Polish entity, LUMEL SA, we have already placed order for new SMT line, which will be operational within this financial year. This wi ll also give us a lot of scope to increase our EMS business and our electronic manufacturing in Poland. Apart from this, we are also in the process of finalizing a new state of the art SMT line in India.

items.statement: Aluminum die casting capacity expansion of EUR 3-4 million postponed/suspended; instead investing INR 14-15 crore in 1.3-1.4 MW rooftop solar at LUMEL ALUCAST
items.quote: we have I can say that we have postponed it. So we want to do it this financial year. Expansion of the plant, we are not doing it. Instead, we are spending some money for solar installation to which will give us a reduction in operational cost. items.quote: One thing I just wanted to add to this, in some locations like Panvel, we have actually been able to increase our rates also by 5%-6% year-on-year. So there is no question of lull in demand.

items.statement: No demand slack in Panvel or Bhandup; Panvel seeing robust inquiries post Atal Setu; Bhandup launches achieve 50-60% booking in launch quarter
items.quote: Yes, so just to answer that part of the question, no, there is no drop in demand. In fact, because of this Atal Setu connectivity, Panvel has seen a robust inquiry. So at the next launch, we will have that inquiry really converted into sales and there is no lull in demand.

items.statement: Balance collections from sold units INR804 crores; pending project costs INR957 crores; unsold inventory revenue potential INR1,577 crores at current prices (40% share Monte South)
items.value: Collections INR804 crores, Costs INR957 crores, Unsold INR1,577 crores
items.quote: As for the cash flows, as of 31st March, 2024, balance collections from sold units, which includes completed and ongoing projects, in all launched projects stood at INR804 crores. Total pending estimated project costs to be incurred stands at INR957 crores. Total estimated revenue from unsold inventory stands at INR1577 crores.

items.statement: Monte South FY24 sales ~INR600 crores vs INR250 crores FY23; construction at super speed targeting OC for Tower A top floor this year
items.quote: Monte South, FY'23, we did around INR250 crores of business and FY'24, we did around INR600 crores plus business. So sales are increasing, as Chetan Bhai said, and collection also is actually directly proportional to the construction and construction is going at super speed.

items.statement: Three balanced segments: South Mumbai (high value), Mulund/Bhandup/Vikhroli (mid), Dombivali/Panvel (affordable); Monte South has INR6,000+ crores inventory to launch over 3-4 years
items.quote: Around INR6,000 crores – INR6000 plus inventory of Monte South is yet to be sold/launched. So that will be coming in the next three to four years as we speak in terms of launches.

items.statement: OC received unsold inventory ~225,000 sq ft valued ~INR380 crores (Futurex commercial INR250 crores, residential INR130 crores); includes 71,500 sq ft leased area in Futurex
items.quote: So around, you know, around 2,25,000 is the area, which is OC received, but unsold. Primarily, the main figure is in Futurex. Commercial sells post OC, quite a lot of it. And Futurex, that's how the sales will happen.

items.statement: Future growth funding may use equity or debt; net worth growing from profits supports further debt raise; equity option also possible
items.quote: Yes. If new development for the growth of the company funds are definitely required. Either it could be from equity or it could be from debt. Now with our equity growing because of the robust profit numbers also getting added into reserves our networth growing from that perspective even further raising debt will not be a big problem and there is a possibility that we may want to look at equity opt

items.statement: Next-gen directors Kaivalya and Samyag Shah added to board; team of ~880 staff; management says utilizing ~60% bandwidth, ample capacity for scale-up
items.quote: We have about 880 people staff. So from execution perspective, if you see, you can say that we are only 60% of the bandwidth that we have, we are utilizing. Why 60%? That is always because of the want of the right opportunity and want of the acceleration in face numbers.

items.statement: Monte South revenue recognition follows percentage completion method (25% cost trigger, 10% agreement value); 40% share not in top line but profits recognized as line item
items.quote: So basically, Monte South is being executed by an FPB. In that FPB, listed company has 40% investment and other partners have 60% investment. So when you get recognized on a person who owns more than 50% and we recognize it as a line item for profits, so it doesn't get recognized in revenue.

items.statement: Quarterly sales volatile due to project cycles, festive periods, launch timing; management advises 12-month view; REIT exploration ongoing but no immediate execution
items.quote: So to look at it quarter-on-quarter I think will not be the right way, at least for the real estate industry. As for talking about the Panvel project, we have a last few towers of our phase 1 which will now -- this financial year, we are expecting Occupation Certificate in all of them as well as our Phase 2.

items.statement: Targets at least 30%-35% presales growth in FY'25 and higher operating cash flow growth
items.quote: With this momentum across projects, we are geared up to achieve a presales growth of at least 30%-35% in FY'25 and a higher growth of operating cash flow.

items.statement: Sold INR1,915 crores in FY'24, a 20% increase over FY'23
items.quote: We sold INR1,915 crores worth of area in FY'24, which is a 20% growth over FY'23.

items.statement: Full-year cash inflows of INR1,236 crores yielded a net cash flow surplus of INR484 crores and 21% cash flow yield
items.quote: Cash in flows, including collections for the full year of FY'24, stood at INR1,236 crores, resulting in our net cash flow surplus during the same time period of INR484 crores. The cash flow yield stood at 21%.

items.statement: Achieved net debt zero with gross debt down 58% since FY'22 to INR295 crores and gross debt-to-equity of 0.09
items.quote: Gross debt is down 58% since FY'22 and stands at just INR295 crores with a gross debt to equity ratio at 0.09.

items.statement: Long-term credit rating upgraded from AA- to AA with stable outlook
items.quote: I'm pleased to report that the long-term credit rating of Sunteck has been upgraded from AA- to AA with a stable outlook.

items.statement: Naigaon project recognized INR284 crores revenue at 30% project-level margin; expects higher EBITDA margins from Sunteck City 4th Avenue in FY'25
items.quote: We have recognized approx INR284 crores from Naigaon, and the project level margin stands at 30%. We are on track to complete Sunteck City 4th Avenue project in FY'25 and due to better realizations, we expect to record higher EBITDA margins in this project from the revenue recognition.

items.statement: Plans to deploy strong cash flows into business development via JDAs and buyouts without compromising IRR, and into commercial properties targeting ~30% ROI
items.quote: We have been doing more of JDA now. Obviously, we'll treat JDA as well as some buyout, but without compromising on IRR and our returns, we are very clear. Plus, we feel now with leasing out these 2 commercial towers on the junctions of BKC. On our investment, we are making like a return of 30% return on our investments ROI.

items.statement: Q2 FY'25: new phase launches at Mira Road and Naigaon; Q3 FY'25: 5th Avenue at ODC Goregaon West; Q4 FY'25 target for South Mumbai launch (Nepean Sea Road)
items.quote: Q2, we are targeting the new phase launches of Mira Road and new phase launching of Naigaon. And in Q3, we are looking to launch a new phase launch, which is 5th Avenue in ODC, which is Goregaon West. And by the year-end, we will be -- obviously, we are trying to get ready for the launch of our South Mumbai project.

items.statement: Mira Road, Naigaon, and Goregaon (5th Avenue) phases together have GDV of INR4,000-5,000 crores; 5th Avenue alone ~INR3,000 crores GDV
items.quote: So if you are talking about Mira Road, Naigaon, Goregaon, all put together, the GDV value of these projects, all 3 put together will be more than INR4,000 crores - INR5,000 crores. So these stages put together. But we are talking -- just to give you a clarification, we are talking a sizable Goregaon, which is Avenue 5, which will be close to 1 million square feet, which itself is more close to INR

items.statement: Nepean Sea Road and Bandstand Bandra West projects each have GDV over INR3,000 crores
items.quote: Both offerings are of GDV value, which is more than INR3,000 crores.

items.statement: BKC inventory sold INR245 crores in FY'24 versus INR203 crores in prior three years combined; expects continued momentum and better sales in FY'26
items.quote: The sales momentum at our BKC inventory has picked up in FY'24 , as we sold last year INR245 crores worth of stock versus only INR203 crores sold in the previous three years all put together.

items.statement: Enabling resolution for up to INR1,500 crores NCDs and INR750 crores equity; no plan to raise funds as company is net debt positive
items.quote: Obviously, we don't plan to raise any equity or increase the debt, we are already net debt positive.

items.statement: Inventory months at under-construction projects stands at eight months, among the lowest in the industry
items.quote: Inventory month at our under-construction projects from the area offered for sale stands as low as eight months, which we believe is amongst the lowest in the industry.

items.statement: Uber Luxury segment outperforming mid-income and affordable; BKC sales accelerated to INR245 crores in FY'24
items.quote: So what we are talking about is Luxury obviously is doing sales much better than -- and faster than the sales of any mid-segment or we are seeing all of us are observing that sales of Uber Luxury segment is faster than the mid-income segment or the affordable segment.

items.statement: Both marquee BKC commercial properties fully leased out with 29-year long-term leases
items.quote: On the annuity front, both our marquee properties around BKC are now fully leased out with long-term lease signed.

items.statement: Planning commercial portfolio at Oshiwara District Center Goregaon West; will confirm commencement plans soon
items.quote: We have also moved ahead on planning for our commercial portfolio at Oshiwara District Center at Goregaon West. We will be able to confirm the commencement plans on this very soon.

items.statement: Maxx World OC received late in FY'24; collections overflowing to Q1 and Q2 FY'25 will boost FY'25 cash flows significantly
items.quote: We got the Occupation Certificate of Sunteck Maxx World in the last month of financial year FY'24 and those collections will -- are coming in the first quarter of FY'25 -- and second quarter of FY'25. So that's why -- that's the reason why there was a slight collection, which has over flown to the next quarter and next financial year.

items.statement: Ready-to-move-in inventory INR1,500-1,600 crores; ongoing projects inventory ~INR1,500 crores
items.quote: So the inventory numbers, the ready-to-move-in inventory is close to around INR1,500 crores to INR1,600 crores and the ongoing projects have an inventory of around INR1,500 crores.

items.statement: Expects strong jump in profitability and margins in FY'25 driven by Sunteck City 4th Avenue completion and better realizations
items.quote: We expect to see a strong jump in profitability as well as margins in FY'25.

items.statement: FY'25 revenue recognition to be much bigger than FY'24 from Sunteck City 4th Avenue, Maxx World, and BKC sales
items.quote: So overall, FY'25 numbers are looking quite strong, but it will be difficult to give any guidance on that. Over and above that, you will have BKC sales as well, which will come through. So that's why we are quite confident of having a good revenue recognition in FY'25 as well.

items.statement: Nepean Sea Road launch targeted Q4 FY'25 but may slip to Q1 FY'26; project vacated and approvals in process
items.quote: We are definitely looking to launch towards Q4. It may go to Q1 of FY'26. I don't promise you that, but I can only tell you that project is -- we have almost vacated everybody, and we are in the process of getting all the approvals.

items.statement: Borivali Eskay project under SDZ policy; approvals expected to accelerate but launch timing uncertain (FY'25 or FY'26)
items.quote: government has come up with a policy for special development zone. So now we see that project getting fructifying that project, and we are working towards planning and other things. and I think very soon, we'll b e able to give you good news on that as well. But we can not promise that it will be in FY'25 or worst case obviously FY'26

items.statement: Aggressively pursuing new projects in MCGM limits, South Mumbai; targets sizable projects and expects good news in FY'25
items.quote: We are looking at sizable projects, and you will see some good news coming in FY'25, for sure.

items.statement: Naigaon launches historically sell INR300-500 crores per launch; upcoming launch exceeds 1 million sq ft
items.quote: And always, if you see Naigaon, whenever we have launched, we have sold close to INR300 crores to INR500 crores in each launch in the past every time when we launched.

items.statement: Management guides for single-digit revenue growth in FY25 with recovery expected from February-March 2025
items.quote: Single digit growth for this year. And so that is how it's going to be for this year. Starting next year, right calendar year, I'm using the calendar year because in the US election will end and then recovery starts, but it may not start till probably February, March of next year is when the recovery will start.

items.statement: Aspirational target of $200 million revenue over next 2-3 years remains unchanged
items.quote: We still want to achieve that number, Gunit. What we anticipated the growth for this year, we have not been able to achieve because of the various headwinds that you are aware of like last year through this year while we wanted to be in the double digit growth, we were able to achieve only the single digit growth

items.statement: Early signs of recovery in US market; Europe flat; India market booming
items.quote: We are seeing early signs of recovery though we are getting inquiries from our customers specifically in US markets. Europe market is pretty much flat for us. Indian market is booming, we are probably in India is the best market in the world nowadays.

items.statement: Management targets maintaining FY24 EBITDA margins in FY25 despite wage inflation
items.quote: Yes. Whatever we have for the whole year, we expected the similar margins for the next year, yes.

items.statement: Pricing pressure stems from wage inflation not customer demands; bill rates flat while pay rates increased
items.quote: The pricing services are not there at this point while the pricing pressure is more to do with inflation of the wage than really anything else. The customers are not asking for such, it's just that even with the market, the tight market that is there for demand and the employees also have the increments that they're demanding is not reduced dramatically.

items.statement: Order backlog stands at 8-9 months of revenue, approximately Rs. 800 crores
items.quote: Let me pull it up. It is about Rs. 800 crores.

items.statement: Added 7 new customers in Q4 FY24 and 29 in full FY24; 80% revenue from repeat customers
items.quote: We also have, I think about 7 new customers in this quarter. Once I'm done with that, Karanjit will explain the different customers that we have acquired and about 29 customers in this whole year

items.statement: 13 AI projects launched successfully; AI revenue currently in million-dollar range expected to grow to few million dollars in next year
items.quote: We have about 13 projects that we have launched for various customers in the AI, and they've gone live. These are successfully launched. We have a huge pipeline that is being built up in the AI space.

items.statement: Two milestone-based government contracts won: Karnataka state HRMS and LIC HR revamp leveraging FCI HRMS solution
items.quote: During the last year using the success of FCI HRMS solution, we were selected to do Karnataka state government HRMS platform that we are deploying, LIC has chosen us also to revamp their HR solution so the whole life of an employee is going to be taking care of us for more in the Karnataka state government, all the employees in the state government as well as the LIC.

items.statement: Product revenue from industrial IoT and hyper automation tools currently ~$0.5M; targeting $20-30M over 3-5 years
items.quote: We are probably in the half a million range of revenue. But we anticipate right over the next 3 to 5 years, 20 to 30 million revenues will be coming in from those.

items.statement: Headcount flat at ~1,800; hiring fluid based on demand with 20+ interns in Hyderabad being evaluated for conversion
items.quote: We are flat what we were last year. Ups and downs were there, there be some people left, but we were back to 1800.

items.statement: Revenue mix: 80% digital transformation, 7-8% SAP, balance consulting; Industry: ISV/Tech 30%, Health/Life Sciences 14%, Retail 12%, Energy/Utility 7.4%, BFSI 8.5%, Media 6.1%
items.quote: For us 80% of our revenue is from digital transformation, right, it is all digital is what we call. So that is the primary side of it. And then we have about close to 7% to 8% of SAP business and the balance is what we call the me-too.

items.statement: Most business comes from referrals; 40-60% from outreach/other channels; direct sales team handles RFP responses and field sales in US
items.quote: There is no concentration saying that okay, we get only from this, but most of our business comes from referrals.

items.statement: Premium pricing vs peers but faster delivery wins deals; competitive intensity high for new logos with 3-5 vendors typically
items.quote: So typically what happens there, Tushar, is our prices are higher, but what we are able to deliver is much faster than the others. So that is the reason why customers pick us because they can produce solution much faster sooner than others usually do.

items.statement: No significant internal R&D spend; AI use-case development done on customer projects and for sales enablement
items.quote: There is no real R&D as such right. We are using internally to see our efficiencies; we can build efficiencies into our own delivery kind of stuff. So, the R&D mostly is done on the job with the customer.

items.statement: Recovery dependent on US/UK election outcomes; slow growth expected for next 2-3 quarters
items.quote: We don't expect major recovery to happen until after the elections that take place in UK and US. So, we are looking at probably the next 2 to 3 quarters, it is going to be slow growth and then probably starting the next calendar year is when we'll start seeing the spending coming back as aggressively as what it is to be.

items.statement: FY25 volume guidance 110-115 million meters; EBITDA margin band 16-18%
items.quote: So that's why we have kept the band, as well as a band for both volume guidance and margin guidance.

items.statement: Branded business revenue target $100 million in next 3-4 years
items.quote: We are confident with the kind of product base and the customer base which we have, we should be able to have at least built up $100 million revenue in the next 3 to 4 years.

items.statement: Branded revenue share target 10-15% of total revenue
items.quote: So going forward, like say if we start with say 5% up to 10% and then maybe probably our endeavour is to go up to 15% of our revenue in the branded business.

items.statement: Q4 FY24 EBITDA margin 15% due to one-time promotional expenses impacting margin by ~2%
items.quote: EBITDA margin of 15% was on account of onetime promotional activities, which increased the other expenses and therefore, impacted EBITDA margin by around 2%.

items.statement: Branded segment EBITDA margin range 20-24%
items.quote: 20% to 24% should be considered.

items.statement: Branded products realizations 15-20% higher than commodity range
items.quote: See, normally, it is like what we've just now mentioned, it is around 15% to 20% higher than the normal range, because there are expenses to be considered.

items.statement: Wamsutta brand launch in September FY25; licensed brands Fieldcrest and Waverly active in FY26
items.quote: Brand Wamsutta, we'll be launching in this spring FY 2025 in this September. So we'll see some traction happening in the fourth quarter. And slowly, we will build up this brand. Also these brands -- licensed brands like Fieldcrest and Waverly also, they will become active in 2025. That is FY '26.

items.statement: Capacity expansion likely FY27, possibly FY26 if utilization reaches 85%
items.quote: That should be considered most like FY '27, I'd say, probably. But if we are lucky and if we are more successful, then definitely, we'll come forth in '26.

items.statement: Zero-liquid discharge effluent plant INR50 crores at Bhilad, Gujarat
items.quote: Yes,at Bhilad plant, because you see, as I mentioned, on the compliance side now, everybody is focusing on zero-liquid discharge. So we need to upgrade our unit. So we are investing into it.

items.statement: Cotton prices stable at INR60,000-62,000 per candy; expect similar band with good monsoon
items.quote: See, cotton prices, you see India is pretty strong in cultivation and producing cotton and that's the reason you see the cotton prices are more or less stable around the INR, 60,000 to INR62,000 mark.

items.statement: US sales >70% on FOB basis; target 60% US / 40% non-US long-term
items.quote: No, our overall mid to long -term strategy is to see that we have like a 60% -40% ratio, 60% in U.S. and 40% in non-U.S.

items.statement: UK FTA primary discussions completed; would provide level playing field vs Pakistan/Bangladesh
items.quote: What we hear is that the primary discussion has alre ady completed. And there are no hitches between the two government to declare the FTA. But they are taking their own time to declare it

items.statement: Maharashtra solar policy allows 4MW per meter; awaiting notification to expand Kolhapur plant from 1MW to 4MW
items.quote: Maharashtra, where we are located, do not have a sound solar policy because they allow only 1 megawatt on one meter. So recently, they increased in the textile policy to 4 megawatts. But still the notification is not out, according to which we can invest i nto it

items.statement: Inventory INR1,143 crores at March 31, 2024 aligned to service higher FY25 activity
items.quote: The inventory for year ended 31st March stood at INR1,143 crores. This should be looked at from the perspective of the increased guidance.

items.statement: Branded business working capital planned on made-to-order basis, not made-to-stock
items.quote: But that will be all planned on the made-to-order basis rather than on a made-to-stock basis.

items.statement: Dividend recommended INR2.20 per share (110%) for FY24; payout 12.89% kept stable for reinvestment
items.quote: The Board of Directors has recommended a higher dividend of INR2.20 per equity share of INR2 each. That is 110% subject to the approval of shareholders at ensuing AGM. The dividend payout stood at 12.89% and has been kept stable in order to use the cash for increased investment in business, especially the recent acquisition and inventory buildup.

items.statement: Value-added segments share improved from 46% to 51% YoY; 7 verticals beyond commodity sheets
items.quote: So we should look at holistically. I have predefined earlier that now we are working on almost 7 verticals apart from the sheet, which is a commodity. So we are working on fashion, utility, institutional, e-commerce, license brand and brand business as well as domestic.

items.statement: Wamsutta brand recall >75% in US; addresses 45+ age; Waverly 94% female recall; Fieldcrest targets 25+ age
items.quote: Wamsutta has a 45-years age and above brand rec all value, Waverly has got 94% feminic c recall value and it is more print and stylish driven as well as Fieldcrest is addressing more to younger generation, 25 years and above

items.statement: Pakistan gaining share due to cheaper MMF (25% cheaper than India) and freight advantage for filled products
items.quote: See, this is due to because Pakistan consumes MMF and in India MMF is expensive by almost 25% where China is cheaper. So India has so far not focused on the fi lled product

items.statement: Red Sea crisis increasing freight costs and working capital by 15 days; universal impact
items.quote: And secondly, one more important thing because U.S.A. is not impacted as such with this, because it goes with Cape of Good Hope, where only you are increasing the working capital by 15 days.

items.statement: India inflation >6% and geopolitical disruptions may delay revenue doubling target
items.quote: See, there are still geo-political reasons for business disruptions, the Red Sea, the war, like various inputs, which are increasing in India. The Indian inflation is like almost more than 6%.

items.statement: FY24 volume 96.8 million meters (+30% YoY); Q4 FY24 volume 28.7 million meters (+41% YoY)
items.quote: Sales volume for FY '24 stood at 96.8 million meters versus 74.7 million meters in FY '23, growth of 30%.

items.statement: FY24 EBITDA INR603 crores (+24% YoY); margin 16.7% (+78 bps YoY)
items.quote: EBITDA for FY '24 stood at INR603 crores versus INR486 crores in FY '23, growth of 24%. EBITDA margin for FY '24 stood at 16.7% versus 16% in FY '23, growth of 78 bps.

items.statement: Pre-sales target of Rs 2,000 crore for FY25
items.quote: This year we have a target of Rs. 2,000 crores internally to get to , again it assumes that the market will remain buoyant the way it is , and we get to launch the phases as scheduled.

items.statement: Expects margin expansion with PAT margin reaching 17-18% gradually
items.quote: I think as the cycle keeps going, we probably get to after tax profit margins and the TCI margins closer to 17%-18% gradually as we go ahead.

items.statement: Targets 15% ROE by FY26 if deliveries go as planned
items.quote: Like FY’26, we will definitely hit 15% over ROE's if things go as per plan as per deliveries.

items.statement: Expects 25-26 lakh sq ft construction in FY25
items.quote: We do expect to do 25 -26 lakhs square foot of construction this year.

items.statement: Achieved highest ever sales value of Rs 1,798.22 crore in FY24
items.quote: We achieved a sales value of Rs. 1,798.22 crores for the financial year 2023-24 which is highest ever.

items.statement: Launched 10 projects totalling 23.19 lakh sq ft in FY24
items.quote: On operations, this year saw the launch of 10 projects, 4 Greenfield projects and 6 new phases of existing projects to the tune of 23.19 lakh s square foot.

items.statement: Expects gross profit margin expansion as construction cost as percentage of sales price to decline
items.quote: But as a percentage of sales price as I said, we are going to see gross profit margin expansion. And I think , as a percentage of sales price, construction cost to come down.

items.statement: Sales price improved 34% YoY to Rs 6,811 per sq ft in FY24
items.quote: Sales price improved to Rs. 6,811 for the year on a per square feet basis vis-à-vis Rs. 5,080 per square feet in the previous year, an increase of 34% on a year -on-year basis.

items.statement: Plans to launch Amarah Phase-4, 5 and Sector 80 project in Gurugram in FY25
items.quote: We have Ashiana Amarah Phase-4 and 5 to launch. We are hoping to launch it in this financial year both those phases and we have another project in Sector 80 in Gurugram which is not too far away from Ashiana Amarah. Also, we are hoping that we can launch that in the 4th Quarter of this year and if not 4th Quarter of this year , then the first quarter of the next year.

items.statement: Has 80-90 lakh sq ft launch pipeline excluding Milakpur land
items.quote: So, we have about 80-90 lakhs square foot to launch excluding Milakpur between our future phases and l and banks.

items.statement: Senior living target of 900-1,000 units/year in 3-4 years from 354 currently
items.quote: Right now, we are looking at from a medium-term view if we can get to about 900 -1,000 units a year from about 354 units a year today as compared to last year.

items.statement: Will not pursue hybrid projects; committed to full senior living projects
items.quote: don't think hybrid projects are the way to go. We don't think they create the value that a senior living consumer wants. Again, these are different opinions and different people can have different strategies. We want to do a full senior living projects wherever we want to go

items.statement: Recorded highest ever pre-tax operating cash flows of Rs 304.46 crore in FY24
items.quote: During the year, we recorded pre-tax operating cash flows of Rs. 304.46 crores which was the highest ever.

items.statement: Buybacks expected every 3-5 years depending on cash flow availability
items.quote: Buybacks will not happen every year. We hope that we do buybacks every 3-5 years depending on the cash flow availability of the

items.statement: IFC holds >30% share of net cash flows in Amarah project initially, then 30%
items.quote: Their percentage share in the cash flows of the project would be a little bit more than 30% in the net cash flows of the project till a certain figure they have a higher share and then becomes 30 %.

items.statement: Targets 27-30% gross profit margin on JV projects at current prices
items.quote: So based on current sale prices and current cost of construction, we typically look for about 27% to 30% on JV projects.

items.statement: Conservative pre-sales guidance due to potential launch delays and project underperformance
items.quote: We might have a launch delay. We don't know what all things go wrong. In my experience in life, there has been only one law that is always applied and that's been Murphy's law. So , we are conservative in that front.

items.statement: Term sheets have ~50% failure rate during diligence
items.quote: But these things are 50% as sometimes term sheets slip somewhere or the other during diligence or something or the other.

items.statement: FY25 profit growth target of at least 20% over FY24's Rs 1,388 crore
items.quote: I think going forward next year, we at least see if all goes well and there are not too many surprises, we should do greater than 20% growth for the year.

items.statement: FY25 revenue growth target of 15-20% and earnings growth of ~20%
items.quote: I think we believe that we shall be able to grow top line wise also more than 15% to 20% and even on earnings growth, also, we are looking at about 20% comfortably.

items.statement: Agrochemicals internal target to triple revenue to Rs 300 crore in 3 years
items.quote: our internal target is that this business has to triple in the next 3 years, we want to go to Rs. 300 crores.

items.statement: Annual capex of Rs 300-350 crore for maintenance and incremental capacity at existing sites
items.quote: we expect that we should spend about Rs. 300 crores to Rs. 350 crores a year is what we are spending in a year.

items.statement: Expanding capacity at existing sites; no new greenfield sites planned
items.quote: We are not building any new sites. But in the existing site itself, we are expanding capacity.

items.statement: RoW business performing well with Brazil at $25-26M, Canada at ~CAD 40M, and strong orders from Egypt and Saudi
items.quote: Brazil, I think direct exports and our subsidiary exports are almost $25 million to $26 million a year. Canadian sub has done nearly CAD 40 million. So, overall, our RoW business is doing well. I think this year , we have some very good orders from Egypt and Saudi.

items.statement: Margins sustainable if product mix holds; conservative 20% PAT growth guidance despite stable margins and 15-20% revenue growth
items.quote: Based on the product mix holding up, yes.

items.statement: Revlimid pricing trajectory driven by market dynamics; no specific guidance on future pricing
items.quote: It goes by the market dynamics. I think that's the answer I can give you.

items.statement: Key pipeline products: Semaglutide (FTF on certain strengths), Olaparib, Carfilzomib, Trabectedin, Imbruvica (subject to litigation), Kyprolis
items.quote: Semaglutide we mentioned, Olaparib we have mentioned. Carfilzomib, we have mentioned; Trabectedin, we have mentioned. So, I think this is all there in the investor presentation.

items.statement: Filed Rimegepant for migraine but faces 7-8 day-one filers; targeting 2-3 first-to-file approvals in next 2 years

items.quote: I have always been mentioning a 15%-20% kind of CAGR growth. And I think we have been slightly ahead of that. But I would expect that there should not be any change in the medium-term growth forecast.

items.statement: Glassware pressware furnace commissioned Jan 31, commercial production started Mar 28, 2024
items.quote: As previously communicated new borosilicate pressware already in Jaipur with a capacity of 25 tons per day was commissioned on January 31st 2024. Further, we are pleased to announce and commercial production of this facility began on March 28th, 2024.

items.statement: Opalware at 80% utilization, room to grow to 100%
items.quote: Coming to opal ware, we are at about 80% capacity utilization. And I think we have a good shot at going closer to the 100% level.

items.statement: FY25 capex budget ~INR 100 crores for de-bottlenecking, solar, furnace rebuilds
items.quote: About INR100 crores in capex this year. That is for some de-bottlenecking, some, another solar project, all put together will be about INR100 crores.

items.statement: ROCE expected to dip short-term then exceed 20% at 70-75% utilization
items.quote: But like I said, as far as calculations, once we are able to hit cross 70%, 75% capacity utilization, the ROCE of this business is north of 20%.

items.statement: Glassware growth expected substantially higher than 11% FY24 due to new capacity
items.quote: I do expect growth to be substantially higher than the 11% we had last year. The reason being as I mentioned, that we are able in the past also, we can add lots of new products and we have also some pricing advantages with our own manufacturing.

items.statement: Glassware and Opalware identified as main revenue growth drivers for FY25
items.quote: So the glassware and Opal ware, I would say would be the two main drivers of revenue growth this year.

items.statement: Inventory at ~2 quarters due to Opalware production at 100% vs 80% sales and BIS-related steel bottle imports
items.quote: We are running two quarter inventory. Like I said, it's coming from Opalware and the BIS.

items.statement: Overall imports to drop below 30%, possibly to 20% in FY25
items.quote: percentage will drop this year. I think our overall imports will be less than 30%. Aditi Bhattar: Okay. Right. Sorry? Shreevar Kheruka: Maybe even 20

items.statement: BIS norms for vacuum flasks causing short-term import dependence, local ecosystem developing
items.quote: We have also started sourcing locally, this product category. And if you can see our working capital has gone up because we have imported, you know, a reasonable amount of stock for this year while we develop the local vendor ecosystem.

items.statement: Board approval for equity raise up to INR 250 crores, not yet executed
items.quote: I think we had already announced that we were looking for permission to raise equity up to INR 250 crores. We've not done anything yet on that but we have permission to raise equity up to INR 250 crores.

items.statement: Advertising spend at 7-8% of sales in FY24, similar planned for FY25
items.quote: It's going to be in the 7.5%. 7% to 8%.

items.statement: General trade largest channel, e-commerce second, weak in large format stores
items.quote: I would not share percentages with you but in principle, I can tell you that general trade is the largest and we do reasonably well, you know, our growth numbers in general trade are quite good. And then e-commerce would be the second largest. In large format stores, we are not that strong.

items.statement: Team built for INR 2,000 cr scale; ESOPs and performance-linked compensation driving motivation
items.quote: We have, I would say, built a team for a INR 2,000 crores turnover while we are at INR 900 crores or even actually before that. So, our size of teams are bigger, probably, than our competitors. I think they're hungry. They're quite hungry for success because their compensation is linked to it. We also have, you know, ESOP schemes, which we give our people.

items.statement: New furnace ramp-up may pressure margins for 2-3 quarters; impact uncertain
items.quote: It's very hard for me to be specific about it and I frankly don't even know. It depends on too many other factors but we are investing in the business from a long-term perspective and therefore 1 or 2 quarters, when we know the root cause of the challenge, I don't think is that, frankly speaking, that important.

items.statement: New pressware furnace peak sales potential INR 250-300 crores at full utilization
items.quote: At full utilization, yes, between 250 and 300, depending on product and prices. Yes, that's right.

items.statement: Non-glassware: bottles and juicers leading growth; double-digit growth across most categories
items.quote: Bottles in general have done well. You know, your insulated bottles have done well. Things like, I think things like your juicers have done well, you know, I think there's a lot of focus on health, healthy products. And those products have done well for us.

items.statement: Non-glassware: #1-2 on Amazon in OTGs, juicers; strong in bottles via personalization; trade channels still developing
items.quote: We are already number 1 or number 2 in some, like for example, OTGs or juicers. We will be number 1, number 2, maximum number 3, okay, in a few categories already. So people are definitely coming in asking for a product or rather putting Borosil as a brand of choice there.

items.statement: Scientific division backward integration capex on hold; not under consumer entity
items.quote: At the moment, so that will now come under scientific division. That will not come here. So that's mainly for scientific. But that's on hold only. I don't think we are at the moment looking to get into that.

items.statement: No specific FY25 margin or revenue guidance given; focus on long-term over quarterly
items.quote: It's hard for me to give you specific numbers for FY '25. All I can say is that the Borosilicate furnace that we've added short-term may have some impact but I would say it would dramatically help improve EBITDA in, say, the coming year.

items.statement: FY25 sales volume target 5.2-5.5 msf, sales value Rs 2,750-3,000 cr, collections Rs 1,700-1,800 cr, handovers 3,300-3,500 homes
items.quote: Keeping that in mind, we have set ourselves a FY25 target of - 5.2 to 5.5 million square feet of sales volume, which reflects the 20% growth from current levels at the higher end. - Sales value will grow by about 27% to between 2,750 crores to 3,000 crores in a range. - Collection should be in the 1,700 to 1,800 crore range. - Handover should be somewhere around 3,300 to 3,500 homes to be handed o

items.statement: EBITDA margin to remain in mid-20s, PBT margin 9-11%, PAT margin ~10% for FY25
items.quote: But EBITDA margin I can assure you that we would be EBITDA PBT and PAT margin should be in the same similar range, mid-20s and about 9% to 10% PAT, which will be very consistent with the what the rest of the industry is doing from a resi side.

items.statement: Target ~10,000 homes delivered over FY25-27, with annual handovers rising from 3,500 in FY25
items.quote: We are very confident of sustaining a growth momentum both in terms of 3,500 units to be handed over in FY '25 as well as a target of roughly 10,000 homes to be delivered over the next three years, '25, '26 and '27.

items.statement: FY24 EBITDA margin 23%, gross margin 34%, PBT margin ~7%, PAT Rs 75.4 cr; margins stabilized in mid-20s EBITDA, mid-30s gross, ~10% PBT
items.quote: EBITDA is at 23%, PBT is about 7%. Net profit is at about 75 crores, which is a new high for us. More importantly, as I said, margins have stabilized in the mid-20s at EBITDA level, mid-30s in the gross margin level and 10% in the PBT level.

items.statement: FY24 sales volume 4.59 msf (+14% YoY), sales value Rs 2,362 cr (+28% YoY), collections Rs 1,390 cr (+16% YoY), handovers 3,000+ homes (+50% YoY)
items.value: 4.59 msf; Rs 2,362 cr; Rs 1,390 cr; 3,000+ homes

Record high collections of Rs. 1,390 crores reflecting a growth of 16% year-on-year. Total handover of a record high number of 3,000+ homes or plots, which reflects a growth of 50% year-on-year.

items.statement: Q4 FY24 sales volume 1.56 msf (+19% YoY), sales value Rs 708 cr (+43% YoY), collections Rs 336 cr (+10% YoY), handovers ~1,400 homes (+84% YoY)

items.quote: On a quarterly basis, for some of you who are looking for a quarterly data, 1.56 million square feet of sales volumes, up 19% year-on-year, Rs.708 crores of sales value, up 43% year-on-year, and Rs. 336 crores of collection reflecting a growth of 10% year-on-year. Nearly 1,400 homes got handed over reflecting growth of 84% year-on-year during Q4 FY24.

items.quote: Delivering & completing 4 million square feet annually for the second consecutive year, again endorses our system capability on the ramp-up, and gives us confidence on delivering 4 million plus kind of volumes annually over the next couple of years.

items.value: Pune entry Q1 FY25; LOGOS resolution H1 FY25
